name: AR 556
notes: Sightmark CORE 2.0 TX kılavuzu (SM13120AR556): 'The AR-556 reticle is a second focal plane, minute of angle (MOA) reticle.'; '5.56x45 55gr FMJ', '100 yard zero'; 'At 4x magnification, the 1 MOA aiming dot is used to engage targets from 0 to 200 yards' -> center_dot=true; 'HOLDOVER YARDAGE (@ MAX MAGNIFICATION)': A 100-200 yd, B 300 yd, C 400 yd, D 500 yd, E 600 yd Holdover, 'F 10 MOA Circle'; 1x'te dış halka 25 yd'de ~15 inç; 'Range estimation and holdovers must be done at 4x magnification.'
